title: portrait preview bound and library delete

commit.merge_subject: merge: portrait preview bound and library delete

description:
owner finding 2026-11-11 e2 ("library'deki videoları silme yapılmıyor.
basılı tutup çöp kutusu ile library'yi temizleme yok"): the library had
no way to remove clips — long-press a row to start selection with that
row checked, tap more rows to multi-select, trash to delete after a
confirm dialog.

ui: LibraryScreen gains a selection mode driven by the pure
LibrarySelection rules (toggle on tap/long-press, prune of ids the list
no longer has; selection is active exactly while the set is non-empty).
while selecting, the title + filter chips are replaced by a stock m3
bar (close iconbutton, count in tabular numerals via Tnum, trash
iconbutton — icons.filled.close/delete, both 48dp iconbutton targets),
the fab hides, and each row's trailing slot shows the check state
(outlined checkcircle unchecked, filled + primary checked) with the
thumbnail kept in the leading slot so rows are still picke
changed: fix: bound the portrait preview to its capped region
feat: library multi-select delete with confirm dialog
